howto.loan_demand.view.summary: After a migration import, open the Loan Demand (the bill the import raised) and the opening ledger entry to see what the import really created.
howto.loan_demand.view.title: How to see what a migration billed and posted

howto.loan_demand.view_emi_bill.summary: The EMI bill is two demands, interest and principal, with the due date and amount; instalment charges are not added to it and there is no CBS journal reference on it.
howto.loan_demand.view_emi_bill.title: How to see the EMI bill and check what it leaves out

howto.loan_demand.view_penalty.summary: After a missed EMI, the system bills a daily Additional Interest demand on the overdue amount; there is no demand called Penalty, and the bill is not the product's penal rate.
howto.loan_demand.view_penalty.title: How to see what an overdue loan is billed for being late

howto.loan_demand_offset_order.create.summary: A payment order says in which sequence a payment settles penalty, charges, interest and principal; the Company holds four, and a product can name its own.
howto.loan_demand_offset_order.create.title: How to see, create and assign a payment order

howto.loan_disbursement.create.summary: Disbursement uses the pledged value as its limit if there is one, otherwise the typed amount; a secured loan can therefore be disbursed before any collateral is pledged.
howto.loan_disbursement.create.title: How to disburse a sanctioned loan, and why a secured loan can go out with no pledge

howto.loan_disbursement.view.summary: From the loan, open the auto-created Loan Disbursement and check its amounts and its Disbursement References section.
howto.loan_disbursement.view.title: How to open a loan's disbursement and check its reference

howto.loan_disbursement.view_ledger.summary: From a Loan Disbursement, use View and Accounting Ledger to open the General Ledger filtered to that document.
howto.loan_disbursement.view_ledger.title: How to see the accounting entries of a disbursement

howto.loan_interest_accrual.view.summary: Each day of a loan has its own accrual row; the amount is the principal times the yearly rate over 365, and a month's accruals add up to the schedule's interest.
howto.loan_interest_accrual.view.title: How to see a loan's daily interest accruals

howto.loan_npa_log.view.summary: When days past due reach 90, the NPA run grades the loan Sub-Standard, flags it NPA, logs the event and moves the unpaid normal interest to a suspense account.
howto.loan_npa_log.view.title: How to see when a loan became NPA and where its interest went

howto.loan_outstanding_report.view.summary: The report shows paid and outstanding principal for a loan as on a date, but has no penalty or charges columns, and no report reconciles interest or matches a payment end to end.
howto.loan_outstanding_report.view.title: How to see what a borrower owes (Loan Outstanding Report)

howto.loan_partner.create.summary: A partner holds its loan share and base rate on its own record; a product only links to it, so one partner has one share across all its products.
howto.loan_partner.create.title: How to create a co-lending partner and link it to a product

howto.loan_product.add_charge.summary: A product's Charges row names the fee and its accounts, but Frappe Lending 16.5.1 does not raise the fee on a loan from it; the officer types the fee on each loan.
howto.loan_product.add_charge.title: How to add a fee to a product, and why it does not apply itself

howto.loan_product.change_penalty_rate.summary: A product change saves at once with no approval, version or effective date; the Version log records who changed which value and when.
howto.loan_product.change_penalty_rate.title: How to change a product's penalty rate and read the change history

howto.loan_product.duplicate.summary: Duplicate an existing product to try a change safely; the copy needs its own Product Code before the first save and starts with no charges, partners or payment-order overrides if the source had none.
howto.loan_product.duplicate.title: How to copy a loan product

howto.loan_product.set_rates.summary: Enter the yearly interest rate and the penalty rate on the product; there is one fixed rate, with no fixed/floating choice, benchmark or repricing field.
howto.loan_product.set_rates.title: How to set a product's interest and penalty rate

howto.loan_product.set_repayment_method.summary: The product's Repayment Schedule Type offers five options; the moratorium is not a product setting and is keyed on each loan.
howto.loan_product.set_repayment_method.title: How to pick a product's repayment method (and where the moratorium lives)

howto.loan_product.view.summary: Open a Loan Product to see the rate, schedule type and accounts that every loan of that product copies. Look, do not edit.
howto.loan_product.view.title: How to look at a loan product's rules (view only)

howto.loan_refund.create.summary: A Loan Refund returns a security deposit or an excess payment; it has a bank reference and blocks refunding more than the excess on Submit, but has no approver or workflow.
howto.loan_refund.create.title: How to refund a security deposit or an excess amount

howto.loan_repayment.check_cbs_reference.summary: No Loan, Loan Repayment or Loan Write Off field holds a CBS balance or journal reference; the officer re-keys the posting into the CBS and notes its number by hand.
howto.loan_repayment.check_cbs_reference.title: How to check for a core banking reference on a posting

howto.loan_repayment.close_loan.summary: A Loan Closure is a Loan Repayment of that type; it can be accepted a little short, the interest gap is posted to Interest Waiver inside the closure with no separate record (DEF-38), and no approval step exists.
howto.loan_repayment.close_loan.title: How to close a loan with a Loan Closure repayment

howto.loan_repayment.create.summary: Create the Loan Repayment from the loan and save it without submitting; a Draft changes no dues, which makes it a manual hold until the bank confirms.
howto.loan_repayment.create.title: How to key a payment as a Draft

howto.loan_repayment.get_payoff_figure.summary: There is no Get Dues screen: the payoff figure is the unsaved Loan Repayment form, and it changes with the Repayment Type you pick.
howto.loan_repayment.get_payoff_figure.title: How to read the payoff figure for a loan

howto.loan_repayment.pay_ahead.summary: An Advance Payment pays the next EMI early and a Pre Payment cuts principal with the EMI kept; each creates and approves its own restructure and a new plan, and Rahim cannot choose a lower EMI.
howto.loan_repayment.pay_ahead.title: How to take an advance payment or a prepayment

howto.loan_repayment.preview_effect.summary: A Draft Pre Payment builds a draft restructure and a draft plan that show the shorter loan, and posts nothing; the three drafts must be deleted by hand.
howto.loan_repayment.preview_effect.title: How to show a borrower the effect of a prepayment before it is made

howto.loan_repayment.recover_write_off.summary: A written-off loan takes only Write Off Recovery or Write Off Settlement; recovery goes to Bad Debt Recovery, and a Write Off Settlement of any size closes the loan as Settled.
howto.loan_repayment.recover_write_off.title: How to recover money on a written-off loan

howto.loan_repayment.settle.summary: A settlement is a Loan Repayment of type Partial Settlement or Full Settlement; a Full Settlement creates and submits its own Loan Write Off with nobody asked, and no offer record exists.
howto.loan_repayment.settle.title: How to settle a loan with a Partial or Full Settlement

howto.loan_repayment.submit.summary: Submitting a Draft repayment applies it to the open demands in the order of the payment order and posts the ledger entries; the split, the ledger and the payment types can all be read afterwards.
howto.loan_repayment.submit.title: How to submit a payment and read how it was applied

howto.loan_repayment.waive_penalty.summary: A Penalty Waiver is a Loan Repayment of that type, submitted with no approval step, no reason and no approver; the before and after amounts are not stored on it.
howto.loan_repayment.waive_penalty.title: How to waive part of a penalty

howto.loan_repayment_repost.create.summary: A Loan Repayment Repost reverses and re-posts a payment's ledger entries and goes from Draft to Completed; it has no reason or approval, and no role can cancel it.
howto.loan_repayment_repost.create.title: How to repost a wrong payment safely

howto.loan_repayment_schedule.compare_pl.summary: Each draft restructure builds a draft plan; after approval the old plan is kept as Restructured or Rescheduled and a new plan is Active, with no link from the old plan to the new one.
howto.loan_repayment_schedule.compare_pl.title: How to compare draft plans and read the old and new plan after a restructure

howto.loan_repayment_schedule.view.summary: Open the Loan Repayment Schedule from the loan to see each instalment split into principal and interest, with the balance after it.
howto.loan_repayment_schedule.view.title: How to read a loan's repayment schedule

howto.loan_restructure.approve.summary: A restructure is submitted as Initiated and approved by setting its Status to Approved; the same user can do both, and approval changes the loan.
howto.loan_restructure.approve.title: How to submit and approve a restructure

howto.loan_restructure.create.summary: A Draft Loan Restructure is the what-if for one loan: save one draft per option, compare the plans they build, and delete the draft you do not choose.
howto.loan_restructure.create.title: How to start a restructure and compare two options

howto.loan_security.create.summary: A Loan Security takes its haircut and LTV from its type; its value fields stay 0, so use the exposure report for what is pledged.
howto.loan_security.create.title: How to register a security (collateral)

howto.loan_security_assignment.pledge.summary: Booking the loan with Is Secured Loan ticked comes first, then a Loan Security Assignment pledges the units; submitting it sets Pledged at once, and the pledge is added on top of the typed Maximum Loan Amount.
howto.loan_security_assignment.pledge.title: How to book a secured loan and pledge collateral to it

howto.loan_security_price.create.summary: A price has a validity period; to change it, end the old row first and then add the new one, because a row that starts inside an older one is accepted and two functions then read different prices.
howto.loan_security_price.create.title: How to set and change a security's price

howto.loan_security_release.request.summary: A release is requested on its own screen and approved by editing its Status; the request is checked alone against the pledged quantity, and the same user can request and approve.
howto.loan_security_release.request.title: How to request and approve the release of collateral

howto.loan_security_report.view.summary: Four reports cover collateral: status, exposure, applicant-wise exposure and ledger; only the exposure reports net out releases, and none shows coverage or shortfalls.
howto.loan_security_report.view.title: How to read the four collateral reports

howto.loan_security_shortfall.top_up.summary: The shortfall record's Add Loan Security button opens a new pledge for the loan, and the app reduces the record itself, but the record has no remedy, owner or due date.
howto.loan_security_shortfall.top_up.title: How to top up the pledge from a shortfall record

howto.loan_security_type.create.summary: A security type carries two percentages: the haircut, which sets the lendable value of a pledge, and the loan-to-value ratio, which drives the shortfall check and releases; any number is accepted.
howto.loan_security_type.create.title: How to create a loan security type (haircut and LTV)

howto.loan_statement_of_account.view.summary: The Loan Statement of Account report gives the final statement of a closed loan; there is no closure letter print format and no notification on closure.
howto.loan_statement_of_account.view.title: How to produce the final statement and what a closure letter needs

howto.loan_transfer.create.summary: A Loan Transfer moves an applicant's loans from one branch to another, but it needs a Branch accounting dimension and a Branch field on the Loan, neither of which this site has.
howto.loan_transfer.create.title: How to move loans between branches

howto.loan_write_off.create.summary: A manual Loan Write Off must equal the whole pending principal and ignores the write-off threshold; the system also writes off by itself from the classification run, with no approver.
howto.loan_write_off.create.title: How to write off a loan

howto.notification.check_borrower_notice.summary: No notification is set up on Loan, Loan Restructure or Loan Repayment Schedule, so a borrower hears about a new rate or plan only if the branch sends a letter.
howto.notification.check_borrower_notice.title: How to check whether a borrower is told about a change

howto.notification.check_failure_alert.summary: Nobody is told: the stock Error Log notification is disabled, and a failed batch sends no email or notification, because the job that starts it still shows Complete.
howto.notification.check_failure_alert.title: How to check whether anyone is told when a job fails

howto.process_loan_classification.run.summary: Classification counts days past due and sets the grade; in production the nightly job runs it for yesterday, and an officer can run it for one loan and a past date.
howto.process_loan_classification.run.title: How to run loan classification for a date

howto.process_loan_demand.rerun_failed.summary: A Process Loan Demand run only ever shows Submitted; a failed night is found in the Error Log, and re-running after the fix bills each loan once, with no duplicates.
howto.process_loan_demand.rerun_failed.title: How to re-run a batch that failed for some loans

howto.process_loan_demand.run.summary: The demand run turns the due schedule row into bills (demands) for interest and principal; the run form holds a date and optional filters, and shows no per-loan result.
howto.process_loan_demand.run.title: How to bill the EMI on the due date

howto.process_loan_interest_accrual.run.summary: In production the nightly job accrues interest for yesterday on every loan; where the scheduler is paused, an officer runs the same job from the Process Loan Interest Accrual form, scoped to one loan.
howto.process_loan_interest_accrual.run.title: How to run the daily interest accrual for one loan

howto.process_loan_security_shortfall.ru.summary: The shortfall check compares each loan with its collateral at the loan-to-value ratio; the form must be saved as a draft only, because submitting it covers every loan and customer.
howto.process_loan_security_shortfall.ru.title: How to check collateral cover and read the shortfall records

howto.report.check_partner_report.summary: There is no partner-wise report; the Lending reports are none of them split by partner, and only an API without a screen returns raw payout figures.
howto.report.check_partner_report.title: How to check for a partner-wise report

howto.report.check_restructure_report.summary: None of the Lending reports lists restructures, reschedules or waivers with a treatment; compliance builds the return from the Loan Restructure and Loan Repayment lists.
howto.report.check_restructure_report.title: How to look for a Bangladesh Bank report of restructures and waivers

howto.workflow.check_approval_limits.summary: There is no workflow, authorization rule or approver field on Loan Repayment, Loan Write Off or Loan Balance Adjustment; the same user makes, submits and cancels each record.
howto.workflow.check_approval_limits.title: How to check what approval limits exist for settlements and write-offs

journey.J1.summary: From the moment the LOS confirms that the money has reached the borrower, the loan system must take over the loan once, complete and correct: book it, apply product rules, build the schedule, go live and load old loans.
journey.J1.title: Journey J1: a funded loan arrives from the LOS

journey.J10.summary: Each partner's share of loans, collections and losses is right and reconciled; Frappe Lending 16.5.1 books the partner's share, but has no FLDG engine, closure share, settlement or partner report.
journey.J10.title: Journey J10: a co-lending partner shares loans

journey.J11.summary: Batches finish, failures are owned and fixed, and corrections leave a trail; Frappe Lending 16.5.1 runs and repairs, but its batches show no result, failures have no queue and cancels need no reason.
journey.J11.title: Journey J11: back office keeps the book healthy

journey.J2.summary: A product owner picks the repayment method, rate, fees and payment order, accounting mode and partners; the BRD wants every change approved, dated and versioned, which Frappe Lending 16.5.1 does not do.
journey.J2.title: Journey J2: set up or change a loan product

journey.J3.summary: Interest accrues daily, the EMI is billed on the due date, Rahim's payment is keyed and applied once, and operations checks the numbers; the CBS legs and the duplicate-payment check are the gaps.
journey.J3.title: Journey J3: Rahim pays his EMI on time

journey.J4.summary: A missed EMI starts daily penalty bills and a days-past-due count; the loan is graded SMA at 60 days and NPA after 90 days, with its interest moved to suspense. Collections, provisioning and a controlled freeze are the gaps.
journey.J4.title: Journey J4: Rahim falls behind

journey.J5.summary: When a benchmark moves, treasury wants thousands of floating loans repriced safely from the right date; Frappe Lending 16.5.1 can restructure one loan at a time, with no floating-rate set-up, selection, dry run, maker-checker or notice.
journey.J5.title: Journey J5: the floating rate changes for many loans

journey.J6.summary: Rahim wants to pay extra, or cannot keep up with the EMI; prepayments, restructures and waivers are shown, approved and recorded. Frappe Lending 16.5.1 has the screens, with no approval step, no regulator category and no Bangladesh Bank report.
journey.J6.title: Journey J6: Rahim asks to change his loan

journey.J7.summary: A secured loan stays covered by its collateral, and security is released only when safe; Frappe Lending 16.5.1 has the screens, but its price, shortfall and release controls have gaps.
journey.J7.title: Journey J7: collateral is pledged, watched and released

journey.J8.summary: The bank recovers what it can from a problem loan under approval limits and keeps the full story; Frappe Lending 16.5.1 settles, writes off and recovers, but has no offer record, approval step or CBS posting.
journey.J8.title: Journey J8: a problem loan is settled or written off

journey.J9.summary: A loan closes only when everything is cleared and Rahim gets his security, refund and letter; Frappe Lending 16.5.1 closes loans and refunds, but has no closure approval, CBS check or closure letter.
journey.J9.title: Journey J9: Rahim closes his loan

lifecycle.ACTIVE.summary: In the BRD, ACTIVE is a loan with a schedule, raising demands and accruing interest. In Frappe Lending it is Disbursed for term loans, and Active only for credit lines.
lifecycle.ACTIVE.title: Loan state ACTIVE

lifecycle.BOOKED.summary: In the BRD, BOOKED is a funded loan that has been accepted and recorded, with no schedule yet. In Frappe Lending the nearest state is Sanctioned, which is reached before the money moves.
lifecycle.BOOKED.title: Loan state BOOKED

lifecycle.CLOSED.summary: In the BRD, CLOSED is a loan with everything cleared, security released and a final statement issued. In Frappe Lending Closed is a status that several different paths can set, and the final statement is a separate report.
lifecycle.CLOSED.title: Loan state CLOSED

lifecycle.CLOSURE_REQUESTED.summary: In the BRD, CLOSURE_REQUESTED is a payoff that has been asked for and is being checked. Frappe Lending has a status of the same meaning, but its own check of the payoff figure can differ from the closure repayment's.
lifecycle.CLOSURE_REQUESTED.title: Loan state CLOSURE_REQUESTED

lifecycle.FROZEN.summary: In the BRD, FROZEN is a loan under an authorised freeze with its processing suspended. In Frappe Lending it is a tick on the loan with a log, and it has no approver or reason.
lifecycle.FROZEN.title: Loan state FROZEN

lifecycle.NPA.summary: In the BRD, NPA is a loan state that triggers income treatment. In Frappe Lending it is a flag on the loan, applied to all of the borrower's loans, with unpaid interest moved to suspense (held back from income).
lifecycle.NPA.title: Loan state NPA

lifecycle.OVERDUE.summary: In the BRD, OVERDUE is a loan state. In Frappe Lending it is not a status: a loan is overdue when its Days Past Due is above zero.
lifecycle.OVERDUE.title: Loan state OVERDUE

lifecycle.PARTIALLY_DISBURSED.summary: In the BRD, PARTIALLY_DISBURSED is a tranche loan with an approved balance still to be drawn. Frappe Lending has a status of the same name, and it matches.
lifecycle.PARTIALLY_DISBURSED.title: Loan state PARTIALLY_DISBURSED

lifecycle.RESTRUCTURED.summary: In the BRD, RESTRUCTURED is a loan whose terms were changed under approval and whose new schedule version is now authoritative. In Frappe Lending it is a restructure count and a watch period, not a status.
lifecycle.RESTRUCTURED.title: Loan state RESTRUCTURED

lifecycle.SETTLED.summary: In the BRD, SETTLED is a loan closed under an approved settlement, which may include waivers. In Frappe Lending it is a status set by a Full Settlement or a short Write Off Settlement, with no approval step.
lifecycle.SETTLED.title: Loan state SETTLED

lifecycle.SMA.summary: In the BRD, SMA is the early-warning grade a loan reaches under the configured band. In Frappe Lending it is a classification code on the loan, not a status, and the move into it is not recorded.
lifecycle.SMA.title: Loan state SMA

lifecycle.WRITTEN_OFF.summary: In the BRD, WRITTEN_OFF is a balance written off under approval, with recovery rights kept. In Frappe Lending it is a status set when a write-off is submitted, and the automatic write-off has no approver.
lifecycle.WRITTEN_OFF.title: Loan state WRITTEN_OFF

screen.customer.summary: The Customer screen is ERPNext's standard record for a borrower; Frappe Lending adds a Loan Details tab and an Is NPA tick to it.
screen.customer.title: Screen: Customer

screen.days_past_due_log.summary: The Days Past Due Log screen holds one row per loan per day with the number of days the loan was past due.
screen.days_past_due_log.title: Screen: Days Past Due Log

screen.loan.summary: The Loan screen is the record of one loan: the borrower, product, amount, rate and term, the totals and status; submitting it books the loan.
screen.loan.title: Screen: Loan

screen.loan_application.summary: The Loan Application screen is Frappe Lending's origination form: a request for a loan that can become a Loan. The team has not analysed the LOS side.
screen.loan_application.title: Screen: Loan Application

screen.loan_category.summary: The Loan Category screen is a short master list of categories, a code and a name, used to label products and loans; the BRD wants it for reports (BR-LMS-106).
screen.loan_category.title: Screen: Loan Category

screen.loan_classification.summary: The Loan Classification screen is the short list of grade codes and names, such as STD and SMA, that a loan carries after the classification run.
screen.loan_classification.title: Screen: Loan Classification

screen.loan_demand.summary: The Loan Demand screen is the bill raised for a loan on a due date: the EMI's interest and principal, penalty or a charge, with its outstanding amount.
screen.loan_demand.title: Screen: Loan Demand

screen.loan_disbursement.summary: The Loan Disbursement screen records the money paid out on a loan, in one or more draws, and posts the accounting entries when submitted.
screen.loan_disbursement.title: Screen: Loan Disbursement

screen.loan_freeze_log.summary: The Loan Freeze Log screen is the record the system writes when an account is frozen or unfrozen, with the date and a reason field.
screen.loan_freeze_log.title: Screen: Loan Freeze Log

screen.loan_interest_accrual.summary: The Loan Interest Accrual screen holds one day's interest on a loan; the daily job creates these records and posts them to the ledger.
screen.loan_interest_accrual.title: Screen: Loan Interest Accrual

screen.loan_npa_log.summary: The Loan NPA Log screen records each time a loan is marked NPA, with the date and what triggered it.
screen.loan_npa_log.title: Screen: Loan NPA Log

screen.loan_partner.summary: The Loan Partner screen is the master record of a co-lending partner: its share, base rate, schedule type, guarantee terms and accounts.
screen.loan_partner.title: Screen: Loan Partner

screen.loan_product.summary: The Loan Product screen holds the rate, schedule type, accounts and rules that every loan of that product copies at booking.
screen.loan_product.title: Screen: Loan Product

screen.loan_repayment.summary: The Loan Repayment screen records money received against a loan, splits it across what is owed, and posts the accounting entries when submitted.
screen.loan_repayment.title: Screen: Loan Repayment

screen.loan_repayment_schedule.summary: The Loan Repayment Schedule screen shows the instalments of a loan, row by row, with principal, interest, total and balance.
screen.loan_repayment_schedule.title: Screen: Loan Repayment Schedule

screen.loan_restructure.summary: The Loan Restructure screen changes the terms of a loan, such as the rate, the term or the EMI, and builds the new repayment plan when it is approved.
screen.loan_restructure.title: Screen: Loan Restructure

screen.loan_security.summary: The Loan Security screen is the master record of one piece of collateral, such as a fixed deposit, with its type, haircut and loan-to-value ratio.
screen.loan_security.title: Screen: Loan Security

screen.loan_security_assignment.summary: The Loan Security Assignment screen records a pledge: which securities, in what quantity, are pledged to a borrower or a loan.
screen.loan_security_assignment.title: Screen: Loan Security Assignment

screen.loan_security_shortfall.summary: The Loan Security Shortfall screen is the alert the system raises when the pledged value no longer covers a loan; the app also closes it when security is added.
screen.loan_security_shortfall.title: Screen: Loan Security Shortfall

screen.loan_write_off.summary: The Loan Write Off screen records the writing off of a loan's unpaid principal and posts the entry to the bad-debt account.
screen.loan_write_off.title: Screen: Loan Write Off
